notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
MVP Achievement bug has been solved.
    The count of creatures is now balanced. This change prevents FPS loss.
    There are some new creature power/durability balance changes.
    Explosion Arrow bug has been solved.
    Some small mistakes have been corrected.
    The game menu has been slightly upgraded.


Collection cards will be added soon.
Thank you for your feedback.
